title: ASHA calls spelling pseudoscience

tellings.quote: spelling is not a valid form of communication they've called it pseudo science

plain: The American Speech-Language-Hearing Association, the professional body for speech therapists in the United States, says that "spelling," a method where people who cannot speak point to letters on a board to communicate, is "not a valid form of communication" and has called it pseudoscience. Ky Dickens, a filmmaker whose documentary follows nonverbal autistic children, tells this without naming a source, as the main professional pushback her subjects face.
